fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects usage of system utilities to discover files and directories
fields.name: File and Directory Discovery - MacOS
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="osx" and ((tgt.process.image.path="/usr/bin/file" and tgt.process.cmdline matches "(.){200,}") or (tgt.process.image.path="/bin/ls" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "-R") or tgt.process.image.path="/usr/bin/find" or tgt.process.image.path="/usr/bin/mdfind" or tgt.process.image.path="/tree"))
